name: Malleco Valley
shape: Chile Decreto 464, drawn from its comunas and provinces

blurb.text: A subregion of Southern Chile, one of Chile's six wine regions. The South runs from the Ñuble and Biobío regions to the province of Malleco in Araucanía, and is made up of three subregions: the Itata, Bío Bío and Malleco valleys.
